subject.title: Improve read tool handling for binary document formats (.docx, .pdf, .pptx, .xlsx) & Avoid Token Waste on Binary Read

question: Should the read tool get a narrow binary-document fallback now, or should this issue wait for broader document parsing/provider-native file work?
rationale: The source-level gap is real, but warning fallback, parser extraction, and provider-native forwarding carry different core, security, dependency, and UX boundaries that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Land Narrow Fallback
options.body: Review, repair, or replace the linked guard so known PDF/Office document reads return a clear fallback message before raw bytes enter context.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Document Work
options.body: Keep this issue open only as context for broader document extraction or provider-native file architecture and close the conflicting guard PR path.

options.title: Approve Parser-Backed Extraction
options.body: Sponsor a parser/extractor design with explicit MIME scope, archive limits, dependency ownership, and security tests before changing `read`.

recommendation.title: Land Narrow Fallback
recommendation.body: Review, repair, or replace the linked guard so known PDF/Office document reads return a clear fallback message before raw bytes enter context.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily product and core-runtime boundary shaping, and steipete has the strongest recent read-tool plus product-routing signal among the likely owners.
